'''Crystal spires''' was a location on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sestria]]. Circa [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Yarr Gatonne]] tracked a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]], [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]], through them.
